_comment: Configurable detection rules, checked in this order (first match wins). 'win_*' fields are counted per source IP inside one FEATURE_WINDOW_SECONDS window. Each rule can have an extra 'and' condition (which can itself contain 'and'). Restart the spark-streaming container after editing.

rules.name: repeated_failed_logins
rules.description: Repeated failed login attempts: potential brute-force activity

rules.name: many_destination_ports
rules.description: Many destination ports accessed: potential port scanning

rules.name: large_outbound_transfer
rules.description: Unusual outbound traffic volume to an external address

rules.name: high_request_volume
rules.description: Very high request volume with small packets: potential DoS activity

rules.name: many_destination_hosts
rules.description: Unusual connection frequency to many hosts: suspicious network behaviour

rules.name: many_accounts_one_source
rules.description: Logins to many different accounts from one source: abnormal authentication behaviour

rules.name: periodic_external_connections
rules.description: Internal host repeatedly connecting to an external address with small packets: possible beaconing

unsw_nb15._comment: Used for REAL UNSW-NB15 flows (topic dataset-flows). No window rules: these flows already carry the dataset's own connection-count features. Detection = Random Forest + KMeans anomaly.
